definitions: One of the twelve Apostles of Jesus Christ and the traditional author of the first Gospel.
The first Gospel in the New Testament of the Christian Bible.
A male given name, derived from the Hebrew name 'Mattityahu' meaning 'gift of Yahweh'.
examples: Matthew was a tax collector before becoming an apostle.
The Gospel of Matthew begins with the genealogy of Jesus.
My cousin Matthew is visiting next week.
